mapper.sql: id, user_id, phone, login_account, password_hash, salt, pay_password_hash, pay_password_failed_count, pay_password_lock_time, nickname, avatar_url, invite_code, inviter_id, status, system_account, last_login_time, failed_login_count, lock_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_member WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_shop_member WHERE system_account = 0 AND (phone = #{account} OR login_account = #{account}) LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM dms_shop_member WHERE system_account = 0 AND invite_code = #{inviteCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_shop_member WHERE system_account = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM dms_shop_member
AND system_account = 0
AND status = #{status}
AND ( phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR login_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.login_account, ''), m.phone) AS memberAccount, m.phone, m.login_account AS username, m.nickname, m.invite_code AS inviteCode, m.status, CASE WHEN m.lock_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS loginLocked, m.pay_password_lock_time AS paymentPasswordLockTime, m.lock_time AS lockTime, m.last_login_time AS lastLoginTime, m.create_time AS createTime, m.inviter_id AS inviterUserId, CASE WHEN inviter.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(inviter.login_account, ''), inviter.phone) END AS inviterMemberAccount, COALESCE(inviter.nickname, inviter.login_account, inviter.phone) AS inviterName, inviter.phone AS inviterPhone, CASE WHEN agent.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS promotionActivated, agent.id AS agentId, agent.agent_code AS agentCode, agent.agent_level AS agentLevel, agent.status AS agentStatus, parent.agent_name AS parentName, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_line_change_application line_change WHERE line_change.agent_id = agent.id AND line_change.status IN (0, 1) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasPendingLineChange, COALESCE(cash_balance.balance, 0) AS availableBalance, COALESCE(agent_account.unsettled_commission, 0) AS unsettledCommission, COALESCE(performance.team_performance, 0) + COALESCE(baseline.historical_team_performance, 0) AS teamPerformance, COALESCE(agent_account.total_orders, 0) AS totalOrders FROM dms_shop_member m LEFT JOIN dms_shop_member inviter ON inviter.user_id = m.inviter_id LEFT JOIN dms_agent agent ON agent.user_id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN dms_agent parent ON parent.id = agent.parent_id LEFT JOIN dms_agent_account agent_account ON agent_account.agent_id = agent.id LEFT JOIN dms_member_asset_account cash_balance ON cash_balance.user_id = m.user_id AND cash_balance.asset_code = 'CASH_BONUS' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_agent_id, COALESCE(SUM(performance_amount), 0) AS team_performance FROM dms_order_performance_detail WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY target_agent_id ) performance ON performance.target_agent_id = agent.id LEFT JOIN dms_migration_baseline baseline ON baseline.agent_id = agent.id
AND m.system_account = 0 AND m.status = #{status} AND agent.id IS NOT NULL AND agent.id IS NULL AND agent.agent_level = #{agentLevel}
AND ( m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.login_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM dms_shop_member WHERE inviter_id = #{inviterId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_member (user_id, phone, login_account, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, invite_code, inviter_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{phone}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{inviteCode}, #{inviterId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_member SET phone = #{phone}, login_account = #{username}, nickname = #{nickname}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dms_shop_member SET last_login_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, failed_login_count = 0, lock_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dms_shop_member SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dms_shop_member SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, failed_login_count = 0, lock_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE dms_shop_member SET phone = #{newPhone}, login_account = CASE WHEN login_account = #{oldPhone} THEN #{newPhone} ELSE login_account END, nickname = CASE WHEN nickname = #{oldPhone} THEN #{newPhone} ELSE nickname END, failed_login_count = 0, lock_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE dms_shop_member SET login_account=#{username}, password_hash=#{passwordHash}, failed_login_count=0, lock_time=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND (login_account IS NULL OR login_account = '' OR login_account = phone)
UPDATE dms_shop_member SET inviter_id=#{inviterId}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE dms_shop_member SET failed_login_count=failed_login_count+1, lock_time=CASE WHEN failed_login_count+1 >= #{lockThreshold} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE lock_time END, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_shop_member SET failed_login_count=0, lock_time=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_shop_member SET pay_password_hash=#{payPasswordHash}, pay_password_failed_count=0, pay_password_lock_time=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE dms_shop_member SET pay_password_failed_count=pay_password_failed_count+1, pay_password_lock_time=CASE WHEN pay_password_failed_count+1 >= #{lockThreshold} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE pay_password_lock_time END, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
